Regarding the dimensions of the desk you saved, it's 48 inches wide and 24 inches deep. The MetroFlex chair should fit comfortably with these dimensions, allowing you to move around easily without overcrowding your setup. If you prefer the walnut matte tone, the "UrbanNest Task Chair" is another great option, with similar adjustability and a compact design. You should receive a confirmation with the exact delivery date once the order is placed. If you have any other questions or need further assistance, feel free to ask! 😊

Most customers find that it takes about 20-30 minutes to put together. It's a straightforward process, so you should be up and running with your new chair in no time! Let me know if there's anything else you need.

Alright, thanks for the heads up. I've put aside some time when it's due to arrive so I can set it up then. Quick question though, are there any specific care tips for the fabric to keep it nice and clean? Between work and dinner, the desk area tends to get quite a bit of traffic, so I'd like to maintain it well. Appreciate your help as always!

To keep the charcoal matte fabric of the MetroFlex chair looking pristine, regular maintenance is key. For general upkeep, vacuum the fabric with an upholstery attachment to remove dust and debris. For spills or stains, blot the area gently with a clean, damp cloth and mild soap, avoiding harsh chemicals that might damage the fabric. It's also a good idea to periodically check and tighten any screws or bolts to maintain its stability. With these simple care tips, your chair should stay in great condition despite the hustle and bustle around your desk area. If you have any other questions, feel free to ask!
